text:
"Design Twitter." Forty-five minutes.

I could explain caching, sharding, and CAP — and still opened with Kafka and Cassandra before asking who the users were or what write volume meant.

Process beat vocabulary: clarify requirements, scope the MVP, sketch the shape, then go deep where constraints collide.

Scope tables, a 45-minute timeline, and the mistakes I still catch on whiteboards.
